qualifier: cyclooxygenase prostanoid and cytochrome P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase branches
name: Cyclooxygenase and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid synthesis
rationale: All members concern arachidonate-derived eicosanoid production and response via COX (prostaglandins, thromboxanes) and CYP450 (EETs, HETEs) routes, unlike confusables centred on lipoxygenase products such as leukotrienes, lipoxins and resolvins.

qualifier: CFTR
name: CFTR-mediated epithelial chloride and water transport
rationale: Members cover CFTR trafficking, its cystic fibrosis defect and transepithelial water transport, whereas confusables are SLC26/SLC12/SLC4 anion transporters.

qualifier: peptide loading, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation
name: MHC peptide antigen presentation and its HIV Nef subversion
rationale: Members span MHC class I/II peptide processing, loading and cross-presentation plus Nef/Vpu-driven downregulation of MHC-I, CD4 and CD8, distinguishing it from CD1 lipid presentation and proteasome-assembly confusables.

core: Toll-like receptor signaling to kinase complexes
qualifier: endosomal TLR and TRIF/TICAM1 branch, including HSE-associated deficiencies
name: Endosomal and TRIF-dependent TLR signaling to TAK1, IKK and IRF3/7
rationale: Members describe TLR3/4-TRIF and TLR7/8/9-IRAK routes to TAK1, IKK and IRF3/7 and their inborn defects in herpes encephalitis, unlike confusables on generic NF-kB, necroptosis or cytosolic antiviral interferon sensing.

qualifier: E1-E2 conjugation steps and transcription factor targets
name: SUMO E1-E2 conjugation and transcription factor SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO loading onto E1 and E2 and SUMOylation of transcription factors, while confusables are SUMOylation of DNA repair, RNA-binding, chromatin and other substrate classes.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
qualifier: RNA and inositol phosphate export rather than protein import or envelope reformation
name: Nuclear pore complex and RNA export to cytoplasm
rationale: Members concern NPC assembly/disassembly and export of mRNA, tRNA, ribosomal subunits and inositol phosphates through the pore, distinguishing it from protein import regulation and nuclear envelope reformation confusables.

qualifier: transsulfuration with choline, carnitine and FMO oxidation
name: Transsulfuration, selenium methylation and choline-carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members share sulfur/selenium amino acid catabolism and methyl-group-linked choline, carnitine and trimethylamine (FMO3) metabolism, unlike confusables on urea cycle, aromatic amino acids, biotin or glutathione.

qualifier: UGT1A glucuronidation and ABCC2 biliary export
name: Heme catabolism to bilirubin and its UGT1A/ABCC2 clearance
rationale: All members cover heme degradation and bilirubin conjugation/export defects causing hyperbilirubinemia, whereas confusables are drug ADME and SLCO-mediated hepatic uptake.

qualifier: sialic acid (CMP-Neu5Ac) and GNE pathway
name: Sialic acid and N-acetylhexosamine phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members cover GNE-dependent sialic acid synthesis, CMP-Neu5Ac and N-acetylneuraminate catabolism linked to GlcNAc and fructose 6-phosphate, unlike confusables on UDP-GlcNAc, lysosomal glycan catabolism or N-glycan processing.

qualifier: promoting storage and macrophage foam cell formation
name: Lipoprotein cholesterol uptake promoting macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members describe lipoprotein-mediated cholesterol import, storage and foam cell differentiation, the opposite direction to confusables focused on cholesterol efflux and HDL assembly.

core: Chromatin assembly and protein lysine acetylation
qualifier: centromeric CENP-A nucleosome deposition
name: Centromeric CENP-A nucleosome deposition and lysine acetylation
rationale: Members combine CENP-A and replication-dependent nucleosome assembly with histone/tubulin lysine acetylation, distinguishing it from chromosome condensation and BAF/CHD remodeling confusables.

qualifier: ABC transporter export into bile, intestine and HDL
name: ABC transporter lipid export to bile, intestine and HDL
rationale: Members cover ABCA/ABCB/ABCG-mediated lipid and sterol efflux, bile secretion defects, intestinal absorption and HDL/LDL remodeling, which confusables centred on VLDL/chylomicron clearance and uptake lack.

qualifier: SMAD pathway negative regulation
name: TGF-beta-SMAD signaling and its negative regulation
rationale: All three members concern TGF-beta/SMAD signaling and its inhibition, distinct from fibrosis, miRNA processing and BMP/mesenchymal confusables.

qualifier: activity-dependent size and fiber-type change
name: Activity-dependent striated muscle size and fiber-type adaptation
rationale: Members cover muscle growth, atrophy, cell size, fiber-type transition and satellite-cell regeneration in response to activity, unlike confusables centred on calcineurin-NFAT, contraction or myogenesis.

qualifier: definitive endoderm and pluripotency exit
name: Gastrulation and definitive endoderm specification from pluripotent cells
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, EMT, mesendoderm and endoderm specification with OCT4/SOX2/NANOG regulation, which lateral plate mesoderm and cardiac confusables lack.

qualifier: pre-mRNA/snRNA splicing, 3'-end processing, surveillance and export
name: Nuclear pre-mRNA and snRNA processing, surveillance and export
rationale: Members cover splicing, snRNP biogenesis, histone and polyadenylated 3'-end processing, nuclear exosome decay and mRNA export, distinguishing it from rRNA/Pol I-III transcription and cytoplasmic decapping/5'-3' decay confusables.

qualifier: classical and alternative pathways and their regulation
name: Classical and alternative complement activation and its regulation
rationale: Members describe classical and alternative complement cascades, C3/C5 activation and their regulation, unlike confusables on lectin pathway or effector neutrophil/Fc responses.

qualifier: common gamma-chain cytokines IL-2, IL-7, IL-15, IL-21
name: Common gamma-chain cytokine (IL-2, IL-7, IL-15, IL-21) signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/7/15/21 signaling and resulting NK proliferation and differentiation, distinct from IL-9, IL-10/12/23 and inflammatory cytokine confusables.

qualifier: NK and CD8 T cell effector function and MHC-I recognition
name: NK and cytotoxic CD8 T cell effector function
rationale: Members cover NK and CD8 T cell signatures, KIR/MHC-I recognition, granzyme killing and its regulation, whereas confusables concern CD4 T cell costimulation and dendritic cell activation.

qualifier: R-loops, protein-DNA crosslinks and transcription termination
name: Replication-transcription conflict resolution and protein-DNA crosslink repair
rationale: Members concern replication stress responses, R-loop processing, DNA-protein crosslink repair and transcription termination, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair and telomere maintenance.

core: Programmed cell death and stress-induced arrest
qualifier: p53-driven senescence alongside intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis
name: Intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis with p53-driven cellular senescence
rationale: Members span BCL-2-family and death-receptor apoptosis plus p53 regulation and oncogene/oxidative-stress senescence, combining what the apoptosis-only and p53-only confusables each lack.

qualifier: white, brown and beige fat with thermogenesis
name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover adipose development, white/brown/beige fat differentiation, PPAR regulation and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis, unlike confusables on hepatic lipid transcription or lipid droplet turnover.

qualifier: Rho-family GTPase cycles driving cell motility
name: Rho-family GTPase control of actin cytoskeleton and motility
rationale: Members are RHO/RAC/CDC42 GTPase cycles and effectors regulating actin polymerization, protrusions and migration, distinct from axon guidance, cell-junction and G alpha 12/13 confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor GPCR signaling
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and chemotaxis
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil and granulocyte chemotaxis, recruitment and apoptosis via formyl peptide GPCRs, unlike confusables on degranulation, chemokine production or extravasation.

qualifier: second messengers and CD27 costimulation
name: Downstream antigen-receptor second-messenger signaling and CD27 costimulation
rationale: Members cover downstream TCR second messengers, ITK/PKC, NF-kB activation and IL-2 production with CD27 signaling, unlike confusables on CD28/CTLA4 proximal signaling, BCR or thymic development.
